title: Jev in Context Platform: recorded synthetic evaluation evidence
description: Selected fields from existing project reports and synthetic fixtures; no new provider calls were made to prepare this article.
scope: Process-binding suggestions only. These results do not evaluate chat field search, production user behavior, or the complete process execution lifecycle.

methodology.accuracy_denominator: Cases whose expected label is not needs_clarification; this includes intentional no_binding (null) cases.
methodology.abstention_denominator: Cases whose expected label is needs_clarification.
methodology.correctness: Final decision after the confidence threshold matches the expected label.
methodology.p95: Nearest-rank per corpus: sorted latency at ceil(0.95 * n) - 1. Adapter-level request latency, excluding author interaction and application workflow.
methodology.workflow: Each stage is evaluated independently with fixture-supplied selections. The workflow corpus is not a cascading end-to-end authoring run.
methodology.holdout: The v3 holdout was inspected and used during prompt improvement; its v4 rerun is regression evidence. The final 12-case holdout was created after v4 was fixed, according to the project implementation record.
methodology.cost: Provider input tokens priced at the recorded Jev 1.13 rate; output priced at zero. Excludes earlier experiments, hosting, databases, application execution, and human review.
limitations: One recorded result per case and prompt version shown
No comparison against another provider or model

gates.notes: Synthetic acceptance corpus. Required correction rate is label disagreement, not observed author behavior. A confidence value is not accuracy. Unknown returned model pricing makes the cost gate unverified. No threshold permits automatic acceptance or publication.
